name: Major Unstable Furniture Archway
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-13: All That Glitters
description: This unsteady pile of furniture is piled to the top of this usually high-ceilinged room. There looks to be some space to squeeze through to the other side, but even the slightest touch causes the stack to destabilize, and there's so much that once it begins to fall, it's difficult to stop.
disable: DC 25 Athletics check to knock the pile over in a safe direction or DC 23 Thievery check (trained) to carefully rearrange the furniture to a more stable configuration.
routine: On its initiative, the pile expands into an adjacent space, dealing creatures in that space 2d8 +5 bludgeoning damage with a DC 21 basic Reflex save, pushing them into an adjacent empty space, and making that space impassable until cleared. If no adjacent empty space is available, the pile buries the creature, suffocating it. Clearing a space or pulling a creature out requires a DC 18 Athletics check.

offensiveAbilities.name: Tumbling Down
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature moves into a space adjacent to the furniture pile

Effect Part of the pile slides into a space the creature occupies, causing 2d8+5 bludgeoning damage with a basic DC 21 Reflex save. The furniture pile rolls initiative.
